note: 族男、族女透過成就＋尋根解鎖傳統服飾；旅人只得到族女縫的小飾品。外來者永遠不穿真正的 Tao 服飾。

review: 族男傳統服飾由誰製作、何時穿著
是否適合在遊戲中日常穿著

text.preEn: M1 (sorted the boat with the crew)

steps.text: 主人家長輩提起族男的阿公
steps.textEn: The host family elder mentions the Tao man's grandpa

lines.zh: 你跟船組整理過船了，很快就要第一次出海。你阿公年輕的時候，也是這樣開始的。
lines.en: You've sorted the boat with the crew, and soon you'll go to sea for the first time. Your grandpa started out just like this when he was young.

lines.zh: 想知道他的事，去問以前跟他一起出海的長輩。
lines.en: If you want to know about him, ask the elders who went to sea with him.

steps.text: 野銀的長輩說起阿公出海的樣子
steps.textEn: The Ivalino elder talks about Grandpa at sea

lines.zh: 你阿公啊，划船很穩，話不多。分魚的時候，總是先想到別人。
lines.en: Your grandpa? He paddled steady and didn't talk much. When sharing fish, he always thought of others first.

lines.zh: 記得一個人的名字和他做過的事，就是把他留在家裡。
lines.en: Remembering a person's name and what he did — that's how you keep him at home.

alt.text: 朗島的長輩說起阿公出海的樣子
alt.textEn: The Iraraley elder talks about Grandpa at sea

lines.zh: 你阿公啊，划船很穩，話不多。分魚的時候，總是先想到別人。
lines.en: Your grandpa? He paddled steady and didn't talk much. When sharing fish, he always thought of others first.

lines.zh: 記得一個人的名字和他做過的事，就是把他留在家裡。
lines.en: Remembering a person's name and what he did — that's how you keep him at home.

steps.text: 椰油的長輩說起阿公的船組
steps.textEn: The Yayo elder talks about Grandpa's boat crew

lines.zh: 我們同一個船組好多年。他補網補得最快，手很巧。
lines.en: We were in the same boat crew for years. He mended nets the fastest. Clever hands.

lines.zh: 回去吧，家裡的長輩有東西要給你。
lines.en: Go on home. The elder at home has something for you.

alt.text: 紅頭的長輩說起阿公的船組
alt.textEn: The Imorod elder talks about Grandpa's boat crew

lines.zh: 我年輕時跟他同一個船組好多年。他補網補得最快，手很巧。
lines.en: When I was young, I was in his boat crew for years. He mended nets the fastest. Clever hands.

lines.zh: 回去吧，家裡的長輩有東西要給你。
lines.en: Go on home. The elder at home has something for you.

steps.text: 主人家的女性長輩把織好的衣服交給族男
steps.textEn: The host family's woman elder gives the Tao man clothes woven at home

lines.zh: 這是家裡的女人一起織的。你要跟船組出海了，也問過阿公的事，可以穿了。
lines.en: The women of the family wove this together. You're going to sea with the crew and you've asked about your grandpa. You can wear it now.

lines.zh: 出海、祭典、部落的活動，都要穿上它。平常想換回來也可以，要記得是誰織的、是為了什麼。
lines.en: Wear it to sea, to festivals and village events. You can change back whenever you like — just remember who wove it and why.

lines.zh: 族男解鎖「傳統服飾」，可在手札的「背包」頁換穿。不包含祭儀用的銀盔、金片等物品；穿著的場合還要請族人確認。
lines.en: The Tao man unlocked "Traditional clothing". Change into it on the "Bag" page of the notebook. It doesn't include ceremonial items like the silver helmet or gold plates; when to wear it still needs checking with the community.

toast: 族男的傳統服飾已加入手札的「背包」頁。
toastEn: The Tao man's traditional clothing was added to the "Bag" page of the notebook.

hint.zh: 族男跟船組整理過船之後，主人家長輩好像想跟他說說阿公的事。
hint.en: After the Tao man sorts the boat with the crew, the host family elder seems to want to tell him about his grandpa.

name.zh: 尋根：外婆的織布與水芋田
name.en: Roots: Grandma's weaving and taro field

review: 族女傳統服飾由誰製作、何時穿著
織布紋樣是否可公開呈現

steps.text: 紅頭的織布長輩說起族女的外婆
steps.textEn: The Imorod weaving elder talks about the Tao woman's Grandma

lines.zh: 你捲線的手勢，跟你外婆一模一樣。她以前常在簷廊織布，一坐就是一個下午。
lines.en: The way you wind thread is just like your Grandma. She used to weave on the porch for a whole afternoon.

lines.zh: 她的水芋田在野銀。去問問以前跟她一起下田的長輩吧。
lines.en: Her taro field is in Ivalino. Go ask the elders who used to work the field with her.

alt.text: 漁人的女性長輩說起族女的外婆
alt.textEn: The Iratay woman elder talks about the Tao woman's Grandma

lines.zh: 你捲線的手勢，跟你外婆一模一樣。我們年輕時常一起在簷廊織布，一坐就是一個下午。
lines.en: The way you wind thread is just like your Grandma. When we were young we often wove together on the porch for a whole afternoon.

lines.zh: 她的水芋田在野銀。去問問以前跟她一起下田的長輩吧。
lines.en: Her taro field is in Ivalino. Go ask the elders who used to work the field with her.

steps.text: 野銀的水芋田長輩說起外婆的田
steps.textEn: The Ivalino taro field elder talks about Grandma's field

lines.zh: 那塊田現在是你家的長輩在照顧。你外婆說過，田要有人走進去，才不會荒掉。
lines.en: Your family's elder looks after that field now. Your Grandma used to say a field needs people walking in it, or it goes wild.

lines.zh: 去看看吧，回來的時候到家裡的簷廊。
lines.en: Go and see it. When you come back, come to the porch at home.

alt.text: 東清的女性長輩說起外婆的田
alt.textEn: The Iranmeylek woman elder talks about Grandma's field

lines.zh: 我年輕時常去野銀幫你外婆的田。那塊田現在是你家的長輩在照顧。
lines.en: When I was young I often went to Ivalino to help in your Grandma's field. Your family's elder looks after it now.

lines.zh: 你外婆說過，田要有人走進去，才不會荒掉。去看看吧，回來的時候到家裡的簷廊。
lines.en: Your Grandma used to say a field needs people walking in it, or it goes wild. Go and see it. When you come back, come to the porch at home.

steps.text: 族女走進家裡的水芋田看看
steps.textEn: The Tao woman walks into the family's taro field

lines.zh: 原來外婆以前就是在這裡工作。
lines.en: So this is where Grandma used to work.

lines.zh: 族女在田埂上站了一會兒。
lines.en: The Tao woman stands on the field bank for a while.

steps.text: 主人家的女性長輩把織好的衣服交給族女
steps.textEn: The host family's woman elder gives the Tao woman clothes woven at home

lines.zh: 這件是用家裡的線織的，有一部分還是你外婆留下來的。
lines.en: This was woven with thread from our home. Some of it was left by your Grandma.

lines.zh: 妳學會處理苧麻、捲線，也走過外婆的田了。穿上它，記得這些手藝是怎麼傳下來的。
lines.en: You've learned to prepare ramie and wind thread, and you've walked Grandma's field. Wear it, and remember how these skills were handed down.

lines.zh: 族女解鎖「傳統服飾」，可在手札的「背包」頁換穿。穿著的場合與紋樣還要請族人確認。
lines.en: The Tao woman unlocked "Traditional clothing". Change into it on the "Bag" page of the notebook. When to wear it and its patterns still need checking with the community.

toast: 族女的傳統服飾已加入手札的「背包」頁。
toastEn: The Tao woman's traditional clothing was added to the "Bag" page of the notebook.

hint.zh: 織布的長輩看族女捲線的樣子，好像想起了什麼人。
hint.en: Watching the Tao woman wind thread, the weaving elder seems to remember someone.

name.zh: 族女幫旅人編織草小袋
name.en: The Tao woman weaves a small straw pouch for the traveller

review: 旅人飾品的樣式（不得是傳統服飾或祭儀紋樣）

text.unlock: 旅人的日常小飾品（織草帽、織草小袋）
text.unlockEn: Traveller's everyday accessories (woven straw hat, small woven pouch)

steps.text: 向織布長輩請教：旅人去晚會可以戴什麼
steps.textEn: Ask the weaving elder: what can the traveller wear to the party?

lines.zh: 要去漁人的晚會啊？傳統的衣服是族人的，外面來的朋友不穿。
lines.en: Going to the Iratay party? Traditional clothes belong to the Tao people. Friends from outside don't wear them.

lines.zh: 不過，讓族女幫你編個小袋子、一頂草帽，帶在身上，這樣就很好。
lines.en: But you could have the Tao woman weave you a small pouch and a straw hat to carry along. That would be nice.

lines.zh: 去雜貨店買一捆沒染色的棉線，剩下的我這裡有。
lines.en: Go buy a bundle of undyed cotton thread at the grocery store. I have the rest here.

steps.text: 旅人到椰油的雜貨店買棉線
steps.textEn: The traveller buys cotton thread at the Yayo grocery store

lines.zh: 棉線？要編東西啊。這捆是原色的，拿去。
lines.en: Cotton thread? Making something, eh? This bundle is undyed. Here you go.

steps.text: 族女向織布長輩拿碎布
steps.textEn: The Tao woman gets cloth scraps from the weaving elder

lines.zh: 這些是織剩的線頭和布邊，拿去用。原色、簡單就好，不要照著祭儀的紋樣做。
lines.en: These are leftover thread ends and cloth edges. Use them. Keep it plain and simple — don't copy ceremonial patterns.

steps.text: 回到簷廊，族女幫旅人編織草小袋與草帽
steps.textEn: Back on the porch, the Tao woman weaves a straw pouch and hat for the traveller

lines.zh: 頭低一下，我量一下……好了！一頂草帽，一個小袋子。
lines.en: Head down a little, let me measure… there! A straw hat and a little pouch.

lines.zh: 好漂亮！謝謝妳，我會好好珍惜。
lines.en: So pretty! Thank you. I'll treasure them.

lines.zh: 旅人得到「織草帽」與「織草小袋」。這是日常的小飾品，不是傳統服飾。
lines.en: The traveller got a "Woven straw hat" and a "Small woven pouch". These are everyday accessories, not traditional clothing.

toast: 旅人可以在手札的「背包」頁戴上織草帽、背上織草小袋。
toastEn: The traveller can wear the straw hat and carry the woven pouch from the "Bag" page of the notebook.

hint.zh: 受邀去晚會之後，可以找紅頭的織布長輩，請族女幫旅人編個小飾品。
hint.en: After being invited to the party, find the Imorod weaving elder and have the Tao woman weave a small accessory for the traveller.
